description_en: This operation from Phone Number-based Service queries an international phone number to identify its country and carrier, and returns the corresponding MCC and MNC
description_zh: 号码百科国际站号码归属服务,用于查询号码归属的国家和运营商(Mcc Mnc 码)
name: DescribeNumberMccMnc

parameters.help_en: The phone number, which must be prefixed with a country code. For example, a phone number in China (Hong Kong) must be in the `85212343433` format
parameters.help_zh: 号码，（号码前需要带上区号）如中国香港地区号码，则为85212343433
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

To obtain an authorization code, log on to the Phone Number-based Service console, go to Tag Plaza (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square), select a tag, and submit an application. You will receive the authorization code after your application is approved
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在登录号码百科控制台->标签广场 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后，会获得该授权码
parameters.name: auth_code
